title: Concept: Overly broad file permissions (python) — review required
description: In python, os.chmod[^)]*0o777 sets permission bits that include world access. Broad modes on code, keys, or data turn any local account into a writer or reader. The remedy is least-privilege modes via 0o755/0o644 least privilege.
applicability: python code and scripts setting file modes; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local tampering or disclosure; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for executables, keys, and configuration.
